subject: history
concept: Writing a full research essay analyzing a significant contemporary historical development, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their essay using a thesis/evidence/analysis organizer
exercise.abstract: Student writes a full essay analyzing a significant contemporary development, supported by specific cited evidence

assessment.mastery_threshold: essay presents a clear original thesis supported by specific evidence
misconception_flags: describes events chronologically without connecting them into one sustained analytical argument

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
